// CASE ts_inorder_trailing_comment_await expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item); // don't await anything else; it's "serial"
  }
}
// CASE ts_worker_trailing_comment_await expect=pass
export async function mapLimit<T>(items: T[], width: number, operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await operation(items[index]); // don't await anything else; it's "serial"
    }
  }));
}
